description: Ansible Renovate configuration for Galaxy collections, roles, and Python dependencies

packageRules.description: Update Ansible collections even with range constraints

Molecule platform images are pinned by digest so the test base image is reproducible. These images (e.g. geerlingguy/docker-*-ansible) publish only a `latest` tag, so pinDigests turns a bare `:latest` into `:latest@sha256:...` and Renovate keeps the digest fresh on its own update cadence.

ansible-test supports Python 3.14 at most (stable-2.20 and devel) and rejects newer interpreters, so .python-version must not follow the latest released Python. release-ansible-collection.yml falls back to .python-version when the caller passes no python_version, so an unbounded bump would build the release artifact on an interpreter the CI never tested. Raise this bound only once the sanity matrix in ci-ansible-collection.yml runs a branch that accepts the newer interpreter.

customManagers.description: Molecule platform images. molecule.yml uses a compose-like `image:` key but is not a compose schema (`platforms:`, no `services:`), so the native docker-compose manager extracts nothing. Parse the `image:` line directly so depName is the repo, currentValue is the bare tag, and an optional `@sha256:...` is the digest — the shape the docker datasource needs to refresh the digest. Covers both layouts: collection-wide `extensions/molecule/<scenario>/` and per-role `roles/<role>/molecule/<scenario>/`.
Keep .python-version pinned to a current released Python
